subject: science
concept: Recognizing different forms of energy (light, heat, sound, motion) in everyday life
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Physical Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Energy) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student identifies real or virtual examples of light, heat, sound, and motion energy around them
exercise.pictorial: Student matches everyday objects/scenes to the type of energy they demonstrate
exercise.abstract: Student names the form of energy present in a described scenario

misconception_flags: confuses the source of energy (like a lamp) with the form of energy it produces (light)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
